business_summary: Meta Media Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, operates as a media company in the People's Republic of China, Hong Kong, and the United Kingdom. It operates in two segments, Art Platform and Digital Platform. The Art Platform segment engages in the publication of magazines and periodicals; provision of advertising agency services; artwork trading and auction; art exhibition and related education; and restaurant operations. The Digital Platform segment operates a digital media platform, which publishes digital media products; and offers advertising agency services, as well as engages in the production of customized contents for brand advertisers. The company also engages in research and development; provision of management and consultancy services; retail sales of imported books; planning of literary arts activities and exhibitions; and website development. In addition, it invests in films; operates galleries and cafe shops; online shop and physical stores for sale of photography artworks; and organizes photography exhibitions, as well as engages in design and selling of advertising spaces; event management services; and art exhibition holding activities. The company was formerly known as Modern Media Holdings Limited and changed its name to Meta Media Holdings Limited in January 2022. Meta Media Holdings Limited was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Aberdeen, Hong Kong.
